purpose: Teach: ゲーテ/プリンセス/モナコ/ボリビア/シオン/有楽町/三鷹/ダーリン

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがゲーテの詩集を読んで下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad is going to read you Goethe's poetry collection.
lines.style: Warm, gentle announcement. Soft opening. Slightly sing-song lilt — sharing something she knows will delight him. Unhurried pace, like settling into a story.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、プリンセスの絵本好きだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I like princess picture books better.
lines.style: Quick, bright interjection. Eager honesty — not competing, just wanting her to know what he actually likes. Small, genuine laugh underneath.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがモナコの絵葉書を見せて下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad showed me a postcard from Monaco.
lines.style: Soft, shared-secret tone. Like she's inviting him into something lovely she witnessed. Warm pause after 'showed' — letting the image settle.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとボリビアの絵本見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I looked at a picture book about Bolivia with Dad.
lines.style: Quiet pride in the statement. Not competing with her story — just wanting to share his own moment. Steady, matter-of-fact delivery.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがシオンの歴史絵本を読んで下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad is going to read you a picture book about Zion.
lines.style: Same warm, gentle cadence as the first line. Unhurried, like offering him another small gift. Slight rise at the end — inviting his reaction.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと有楽町で映画観たいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I want to go see a movie with Dad in Yurakucho.
lines.style: Wistful, specific wish. Not demanding — more like thinking out loud to someone who might help make it happen. Soft, hopeful lilt.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが三鷹のジブリ美術館に連れて行って下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad is taking you to the Ghibli Museum in Mitaka.
lines.style: Warm announcement with gentle excitement beneath. Slight breath before 'Mitaka' — the reveal. Knowing smile in her voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんがママをダーリンと呼ぶの聞いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I heard Dad call Mom 'darling.'
lines.style: Quiet, startled observation. Slight blush in the delivery — caught something intimate but genuine. Small, knowing smile. Not mocking — almost tender about it.
